android.desc:
✨ Master the grid. Challenge your mind. Dive into INVERTA. ✨

INVERTA is a premium, cyberpunk-minimalist puzzle experience designed to push your spatial reasoning, logic, and speed to the absolute limit. Simple to learn, but truly demanding to master. 🧠

THE MISSION 🎯
Flip rows and columns on your grid to align the colors and match the target-pattern perfectly. Every single tap counts! As you progress, the logic deepens, grids scale up, and the puzzles evolve. 🔄

🕹️ SIX EXCITING GAME MODES:
• ⚡ Campaign Journey: Over 100+ handcrafted stages that scale from beginner grids to mind-melting logic nodes.
• ⚔️ NEW Duel Mode: Challenge a friend to an intense 2-player spatial battle! Play side-by-side on the same screen (Local Split Screen) or set up a room code to battle online in 1-Minute Sprints or 3-Minute Endurance tests.
• 📅 Puzzle of the Day: Access the daily decryption terminal. Solve the unique daily challenge under the target time to score massive EXP!
• 💀 Survival Mode: Test your focus and reflexes in an endless, fast-paced target-matching streak under pressure.
• 🧠 Memory (Lights Out): Tap cells to invert them and their adjacent neighbors. Extinguish all lights with mathematical deduction.
• 🌀 Parallel Universe: Step into an infinite, procedurally generated target dimension. The ultimate sandbox for master grid-flippers.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE INVERTA:
• 🌑 Premium Dark Aesthetics: Sleek glassmorphism layouts and high-contrast cyberpunk neon visual accents.
• ⚡ Ultra-Satisfying Feedback: Spring-driven animations, floating background particles, and crisp haptic feedback make every move feel great.
• 🧘 Stress-Free Options: No pressure timers in Campaign Mode—solve at your own absolute pace.
• 📶 Play Anywhere: Fully playable offline with no active internet required.

Whether you have 1 minute of spare time or 1 hour of deep focus, INVERTA is the ultimate aesthetic brain workout.

Are you ready to flip the script? Download now and start solving! 🚀
